name: cng-map-widgets
description: Composable, zero-build browser widgets for cloud-native geospatial data: find an area - search a published gazetteer, upload a GeoJSON, draw one - then act on it, filtering and downloading datasets or clipping rasters, entirely over HTTP range requests against object storage. MapLibre and OpenLayers adapters.

scripts.test: node --test packages/spec/test/*.test.js packages/geocoder-core/test/*.test.js packages/upload-core/test/*.test.js packages/maplibre/test/*.test.js packages/openlayers/test/*.test.js packages/download-core/test/*.test.js packages/format-gpkg/test/*.test.js packages/format-shapefile/test/*.test.js packages/format-flatgeobuf/test/*.test.js packages/format-extras/test/*.test.js packages/raster-core/test/*.test.js
